name: Moichiro Sanada
source:
Moichiro is a public prosecutor with a chip on his shoulder. justified by a life-long cycle of rejection. He was a troubled child and a delinquent, often used as a negative example for others to avoid until ending up in juvie. There he was given another chance, being mentored into an upstanding yet still fiery officer of the court, devoting himself to unconforming justice. Given his unbroken conviction record, Moichi is notorious as a prosecutor to many on either side of the law.
